packageRules.description: Base images in the Dockerfiles are pinned by digest, so a digest change must arrive as a proposed PR (config:recommended defaults to pinDigests: false, which would leave every pin stale). Compose references stay tag-pinned: docker-compose.yml builds i3x2ua-local and docs/examples pull the published gateway's floating master tag.

infrastructure/opcua/recovery.py and conf-test-server/server.py use asyncua internals, so major and minor bumps must be decided by hand against the conformance suite; lockfile maintenance must not move the pin either.
Patch bumps are proposed, but the same internals mean they must pass CI before merging.
